Today, we're introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster in your project management workspace. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture your exact setup, including filters, grouping, and sorting, and return to it instantly whenever you need it. Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, sprint, or client without losing track of your favorite setups. Views aren't just for you. Share any saved view with your team so everyone looks at the same filtered list, whether that's this week's urgent tasks, overdue items, or work assigned to a specific teammate. It keeps everyone aligned without repeating setup work. It's a small change that saves real time every day, and we hope you enjoy the extra flexibility it brings.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
